relation_policy.exact_CHEBI_identity: Same canonical ChEBI identifier after alternate-ID resolution.
relation_policy.explicit_conjugate_acid_base: A directly recorded ChEBI conjugate acid/base counterpart, without a structural-class or isomer inference.
relation_policy.same_formula_is_a_descendant: Same-formula and same-charge ChEBI is_a descendant of the exact feature chemical or its explicit acid/base counterpart. This is a structural-isomer/position sensitivity, not direct feature identity.
